about: Constitution texts found on nations' own websites by the governance website pass on 2026-11-23 that the constitution catalog did not hold (no captured text with the same SHA-256). scripts/governance/add_site_constitutions.py adds each to the catalog. Dates are read from each text's first page.

texts.label: 2026 constitution, as amended
texts.title: Constitution of the Comanche Nation
texts.author: Comanche Nation, Oklahoma
texts.note: The first page gives ratification on Nov. 19, 1966 and amendments through May 16, 2026.

texts.label: 2025 constitution, as revised
texts.title: Constitution
texts.author: Central Council of the Tlingit & Haida Indian Tribes

texts.label: 1996 constitution and bylaws, with later amendments
texts.title: 1996 Meherrin Tribal Constitution and Bylaws
texts.history_title: Constitution and Bylaws of the Meherrin Indian Tribe
texts.author: Meherrin Tribe of North Carolina
texts.note: The first page gives adoption on May 11, 1996; an editor's note says later amendments are reproduced as they appear in the source document.

texts.history_title: The Constitution of the Gabrielino/Tongva Nation
texts.author: Gabrielino/Tongva Nation
